rationale.consistency: CreateOrFindLoadTest mirrors v6 idioms well, but provisioning errors aren't 401/403-classified like v6 despite the requirement and the CheckResponse comment claiming so; raw HTTP used while an SDK APIClient is built and never used.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles 409, nil upload URL, aborted/completed during wait, ctx cancel, empty body EOF; misses typed 401/403, always sets secrets config even when endpoint empty, int32 truncation of archive size, non-abort errors get code 0 rather than null.
rationale.scope: Core flow is in place; extras include an unused apiClient field, a new clientcfg constants package not adopted by v6, and runtime-config tuning mapping beyond the stated ask.
rationale.readability: Clear names, focused functions, helpful doc comments; the CheckResponse comment describes behaviour (httperr classification) the code does not implement.
rationale.robustness: Retry/body-replay and context handling are sound, but lazyInitProvisioning sets provisioningMode before a fallible client build, leaving a nil notifier that StopWithTestError dereferences; ignored GetBody errors.
rationale.maintainability: Notify only needs a raw client yet the output builds a full provisioning+v6 client; two http.Clients plus dead SDK client in Client; retry constants duplicated rather than shared with v6.
